_comment: NAMED CONFORMANCE GAPS of the LLM plane: places where busbar emits what the PROVIDER'S OWN
DOCUMENTATION describes but the provider's PUBLISHED machine-readable spec does not admit. The
owner has looked at each one and decided the product is right and the published document is
incomplete. Same shape of decision as testing/shadow-oracle/accepted-differences.json, and the
* A gapped row is NEVER a silent pass. It is written to the ledger with the row class `gap`,
printed in its own column, kept out of the owed set, and counted in the verdict's gap count.
* A gap is PINNED TO A SPEC DIGEST. `spec_digest` is the digest of the published document the
gap was confirmed against; `review_at` restates it as the point of re-confirmation. When
spec-digests.tsv moves, the gap goes STALE: it stops forgiving anything and the rig is RED
until a human re-reads the new document and re-confirms (or deletes) the entry.
* AN UNUSED GAP IS A LIE. Every entry owes a `named-gap|<id>` ledger row; an entry that fired
zero times is RED, exactly like a probe that did not run.
* Nothing here touches the validator's schema logic. The checker still fails the row; this
register only decides what the failure is CALLED, and only for the exact violation named.
Fields: `cells` are regexes over the shadow-oracle cell id, `schema_path` is the spec address
the row was judged against (a gap for one schema never forgives another), and `violation` is the
exact pointer/rule/detail the checker produces — every violation on the row must match, or the

gaps.reason: Anthropic DOCUMENTS `ping` as an event a message stream may carry at any point ('Event types ... ping'), and real native Anthropic streams emit it; the published OpenAPI document's MessageStreamEvent union simply does not list the member. busbar injects one `event: ping` after the translated `message_start` of an ingress-Anthropic cross-protocol stream so a translated stream looks like the native one it claims to be. A client that cannot take `ping` is not an Anthropic client, so the product keeps the frame and the PUBLISHED SPEC is the thing with the gap. Delete this entry the day the union gains the member.
